_comment: Copy to Channels_Data/<channel>/DATA/<channel>.json. Keys marked (required) must be set; the rest may be empty strings to disable a feature.
BotTwitchAuth: oauth:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx (required; IRC token of the bot account)
TApiAccessToken: broadcaster user token: channel:manage:predictions channel:manage:polls channel:manage:redemptions moderator:manage:banned_users moderator:manage:chat_messages moderator:read:chatters channel:manage:moderators channel:manage:vips user:manage:whispers clips:edit
StreamElementsApiToken: JWT token (chat replies and song requests go through StreamElements)
YouTubeApiToken: Google API key for song request validation
ZakazTrekaId: channel points reward id: song request
UvalId: reward id: timeout an unsubscribed user
ApiPublicUrl: https://bot.example.com (public URL of the web panel; OAuth redirect is {ApiPublicUrl}/api/auth/callback)
TApiClientSecret: twitch application client secret (web panel login only)
ApiClientId: optional: client id of your own Twitch application for the panel login, when TApiClientId belongs to a token-generator app
